# minimon-core (vendored)

The Pokémon Mini emulator core from [minimon.js](https://github.com/asterick/minimon.js)
(Bryon Vandiver, ISC license — see `LICENSE`), vendored here as the ground-truth S1C88
machine for the sdcc88 codegen test harness (`tests/emu/`).

Originally vendored from minimon.js commit `c3c3c9336111e1e0482a1138e583c686c3b1fb36`,
then **pruned to a minimal CPU + memory + core-peripheral harness** (the codegen tests
need no display/sound): the LCD, blitter, and audio modules were removed, the control
register was reduced to three side-effect-free bytes (memory is always accessible), and
RAM + cartridge were merged into one unified writable `memory[]` array so far writes to
ROM-space physical addresses stick. The CPU executes only off OSC3; the OSC1 (32 kHz)
derivation is kept for the timers/RTC/TIM256.

- `src/` — the emulator core (`*.cc`): CPU, IRQ, timers, RTC, TIM256, control, input,
  GPIO, EEPROM
- `include/` — its headers, including the embedded free BIOS image
- `table.h` — the opcode dispatch table. GENERATED by `tools/table.py` but checked
  in, pinned at this vendored version (`python3 tools/table.py > table.h` to refresh)
- `tools/` — `table.py` + `s1c88.csv`, the generator inputs for `table.h`

The core is plain C++17 with no dependencies; the host glue it expects
(`get_machine`, `debug_print`) is provided by `tests/emu/runner.cc`.
